convention: T_A_B maps column-vector coordinates from B to A: p_W = R_W_C p_C + t_W_C

board_rgb_pnp.method: RGB marker contour centers and measured mocap board-corner coordinates; no ARCode size needed

ball_rgbd_similarity.method: Similarity fit using approximate sphere centers from RGB silhouette and recorded depth
ball_rgbd_similarity.note: Scale converts raw camera depth units to metres before applying this rigid T_W_C; not independently verified device units

limitations: Neither transform is T_torso_C or a verified deployment calibration.
No independent physical-position holdout; fit error is not validation accuracy.
Board and ball results disagree; group-to-group mounting invariance is unproven.
Depth units, color_z registration, silhouette radius and marker identity require confirmation.
Exported World basis is preserved; physical axis convention remains unconfirmed.
